step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify Visual Nodes on the Whiteboard:
- Node 0: AWS Amplify icon at top left, labeled with 'RCC HOURS'.
- Node 1: AWS Step Functions icon at lower left, labeled with 'PRODUCT' and 'PRICING'.
- Node 2: Amazon Aurora database icon in the center.
- Node 3: AWS Lambda icon at the top right (Menu Exporter).
- Node 4: External 'DELIVERY AGGREGATOR' cloud icon at the far right (actor 'ThirdParty').
- Node 5: AWS API Gateway icon at the bottom right.
- Node 6: AWS Lambda icon at the lower right / middle (Webhook Receiver).

2. Trace Direct Arrow Edges:
- Edge 0: From Amplify (Node 0) to Aurora (Node 2) - Restaurant hours data feed.
- Edge 1: From Step Functions (Node 1) to Aurora (Node 2) - Product, pricing, and tax batch integration.
- Edge 2: From Aurora (Node 2) to Top Lambda (Node 3) - Fetch data to build JSON menus.
- Edge 3: From Top Lambda (Node 3) to Delivery Aggregator (Node 4) - Push generated menus to third-party delivery aggregators.
- Edge 4: From Delivery Aggregator (Node 4) to API Gateway (Node 5) - Delivery aggregators send status webhooks back.
- Edge 5: From API Gateway (Node 5) to Bottom Lambda (Node 6) - Routes webhooks to the processor Lambda.
- Edge 6: From Bottom Lambda (Node 6) to Aurora (Node 2) - Updates audit tables indicating menu status is live.

graph.name: Taco Bell - Menu Middleware and Data Integration Platform
graph.notes: System processes restaurant hours, products, pricing, and tax info into Amazon Aurora to dynamically generate 40k menus sent to third-party delivery aggregators with webhook feedbacks.

nodes.name: Amplify (RCC Hours)
nodes.notes: Deploys React app for Restaurant Control Center (RCC) where restaurant hours are maintained.

nodes.name: Step Functions (Diablo)
nodes.notes: Orchestrates Diablo batch data pipelines loading product, pricing, and tax data into Aurora.

nodes.name: Amazon Aurora
nodes.notes: Core MySQL database holding store hours, products, and 100M+ pricing combinations.

nodes.name: Menu Exporter Lambda
nodes.notes: Processes menus out of Aurora and generates complex JSON menus.

nodes.name: Delivery Aggregator
nodes.notes: External delivery channels receiving raw menu JSON data.

nodes.name: API Gateway
nodes.notes: Receives incoming webhooks from delivery aggregators.

nodes.name: Webhook Processor Lambda
nodes.notes: Processes webhooks and updates audit log status in Aurora.

edges.notes: Loads store hours into Aurora database.
Loads product, pricing, and tax details into Aurora.
Reads menu and store data from Aurora.
Sends generated JSON menus to delivery aggregators.
Delivery aggregators trigger webhooks reporting menu status.
API Gateway routes webhook payload to Lambda.
Lambda updates audit records in Aurora database.
